name: Li Tuan
bio: Li Tuan is dated by Giles to the 8th or 9th century AD. His poem here is on the power of music.
The poems here are Herbert A. Giles’s versions in Chinese Poetry in English Verse (1898), given with the poet’s name as spelled in that book.

poems.title: Music Hath Charms
poems.author: Li Tuan
poems.text:
Hark to the rapturous melody!
Her white arm o'er the lute she flings
To break her lover's reverie
She strikes a discord on the strings.

poems.title: On Hearing Her Play the Harp
poems.author: Li Tuan
poems.translator: trans. Witter Bynner and Kiang Kang-hu (1929)
poems.text:
Her hands of white jade by a window of snow
Are glimmering on a golden-fretted harp —
And to draw the quick eye of Chou Yü,
She touches a wrong note now and then.
